description:
Pattern β with shape change. Currently typed as opaque Option<Value>; should match tasks-types canonical Option<HashMap<String, PatchObject>>.

File: crate-jmap-calendars-types/src/event.rs:193

  // Before
  pub recurrence_overrides: Option<serde_json::Value>,
  // After
  pub recurrence_overrides: Option<HashMap<String, jmap_types::PatchObject>>,

Doc-comment already says 'Map of LocalDateTime string → PatchObject for per-occurrence overrides.' PLAN.md:150 corroborates 'PatchObject map; keys are LocalDateTime strings'.

Cookie-cutter rationale: tasks-types Task::recurrence_overrides is already shaped as Option<HashMap<String, Value>> (sibling bead migrates the value type). Calendars-types is currently divergent — using Option<Value> as an opaque carrier. The canonical shape for the family is Option<HashMap<String, PatchObject>>; this bead unifies calendars to match.

Wire format byte-identical (the JSON serialization is the same regardless of whether the outer map is typed or Value-wrapped).

## Scope

- Shape change + value-type change in calendars-types/src/event.rs (1-2 lines + import).
- Consumer code: any code that constructs CalendarEvent literals OR pattern-matches on recurrence_overrides as Value will break and need migration. Survey before doing the work.
- PLAN.md §1 Sloppy-Value justification: this field WILL stop being Sloppy-Value at the outer envelope (the inner PatchObject leaves remain Value, which preserves the existing rationale for per-leaf flexibility). Update PLAN.md row.
- Cross-check: jscalendar.rs hybrid typed module may have a parallel typed shape worth referencing in a doc-comment.

## Acceptance criteria

cargo test --workspace clean, lib clippy clean, wire format byte-identical, PLAN.md updated.
title: Migrate CalendarEvent::recurrence_overrides to PatchObject (β, with shape change)
